name: zeffect_spawn_runtime_instance_at
description: zEffect::SpawnRuntimeInstanceAt returns the runtime initialized flag, acquires and activates an effect runtime entry for valid indices, then activates the effect node and installs RuntimeNodeActionCallback.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Functional coverage checks the guard paths and the successful spawn/activation/runtime callback flow.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja reconstruction and assembly for 0x461f00 validate returning g_zEffect_RuntimeManager.initialized, skipping acquisition when uninitialized or effectIndex is -1, AcquireRuntimeEntryByIndex call, null-entry skip, ActivateRuntimeEntryAtPosition call, effect node active set, callbackContext set to the runtime entry, and action callback set to RuntimeNodeActionCallback.

The native spawn smoke verifies uninitialized and -1 guard behavior without fresh allocation. zeffect_init_smoke verifies successful spawn, activation count, active flag, callback installation, parent attachment, runtime callback recycle, and later reuse through AcquireRuntimeEntryByIndex.
